description: Release all six IVE EPIC source-unique licensed photographs from the same 2024-06-13 Amsterdam show. Verified full 6-member contact sheet in assets/previews/ive_spotlight_epic/CONTACT_SHEET.png. REI solo image 40 replaces invalid group image 24. All art via common card master template; original CC BY-SA credits kept.

sets.source_collection: IVE Show What I Have World Tour, Ziggo Dome Amsterdam — alternative original photographs taken 13 June 2024 by Robbie Klinkenberg

cards.source_note: Different original photo from published RARE set, same photographer and concert. Full-face 3:4 crop to inspect.
cards.quality_review: Manual review of six individual rendered 900x1200 preview PNGs in assets/previews/ive_spotlight_epic/CONTACT_SHEET.png after candidate REI switched to licensed original #40; six recognizable solo members and no second faces.
